CustomField.description: API name of a field on the lookup's target object used to resolve the CSV cell to a record Id, instead of requiring the literal Id.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional; applies only to non-polymorphic lookup and master-detail columns. Leave blank to require the exact 15 or 18-character record Id in the CSV cell. A value that resolves to zero or more than one record fails the row.
CustomField.label: Lookup Match Field
